text:
24:07 i love the detail of boxten’s twisted form dawning a manic grin. on surface level, you could think that this mf is just crazy like that—that he actually enjoys the bloodlust of twisted-on-twisted combat. but there’s so much more to be read in his expression.
it almost looks like a pained smile, especially with the stream of ichor leaking from his eye. it’s as if he’s gritting his teeth. He doesn’t want to hurt finn, but knows he has no choice. He is gardenview’s only protector, operating in secret. we know by now that boxten is someone who genuinely wants to help others. He’s not like other toons like dandy or sprout, who readily use their power to hurt others. 
he’s shaking, even more than twisted finn is, as though the negative emotion he’s channeling to access his half-twisted form is somehow even more distressing than that which finn currently feels. or perhaps holding this half-twisted form is taking more effort than he’d ever like to admit to anyone. It takes so much restraint that he doesn’t move from the spot in which he initially transformed. his feet stay firmly planted on the ground, as if be’s afraid of even the slightest chance of losing control. but he has to do this. he has to hold it together—because if not him, then who? 
all the world can trust you to be there at its darkest hour, boxten the music box. but when you, its bodacious purple guardian angel, is in need of saving, who will come to your aid?
